title: Starting an ACT tenancy
description: The documents and steps before and when an ACT tenant signs. Summarised from act.gov.au renting pages and the ACT Revenue Office.

sources.title: How to lodge a bond or security deposit

items.title: Put the rent, EER, special conditions, accessibility and ceiling insulation compliance in your ad
Don't invite rent above the advertised price, take a holding deposit or charge to inspect
Prepare the agreement with the standard residential tenancy terms
Give the tenant the ACT Renting Book or tell them where to find it
Give the energy efficiency rating statement, if there is one
Give the asbestos assessment report or asbestos advice
Give a statement on whether the home meets the ceiling insulation standard
Give safety information for any regulated pool or spa
For a unit, give the unit title rental certificate
Check smoke alarms comply with AS 3786 and work
Take no more than 4 weeks' rent as bond and up to 2 weeks' rent in advance
Lodge the bond with the Rental Bonds Office within 2 weeks (4 weeks for an agency)
Give a signed copy of the agreement, receipts and one set of keys per tenant
Give 2 copies of the condition report within 1 day of move-in
items.detail: The ACT condition report form from the ACT Revenue Office can be used. The tenant has 2 weeks to return a signed copy.
